headline: VIPER PIT's select screen finally looks like an arcade cabinet
lede: Five fighters now hold five distinct poses on their cards, fill them head to toe, and pop as a whole tile when you hover or tap them. Three layout bugs and a factory-freezing harness bug came out with them; both fixes are parked for the first green nightly.

notes.text: VIPER PIT select-screen polish (#2172) is built and gated — five signature card poses, hover/tap zoom, tap-to-hover — waiting on the #601 freeze to merge as PR #2174.

Every portrait was cropping its fighter's head. Measured on the transparent portrait canvas (nyx 0.000, riv 0.000), fixed by computing framing from the posed rig instead of hand-tuned camera distances — now 0.043..0.930, full body, nothing clipped.
The hover zoom used to push heads through the card frame; the whole tile pops now, with a warm-ink gate and a permanent __VIPER_SPILL__ prove-fail so the bug can't come back quietly.

The nightly wasn't failing on this game: watchcheck budgeted its waits in real milliseconds while the sim needs world ticks, which is why defender then fire-crew flaked. Filed #2179, fixed in PR #2180, with the tick counts added to the notes.
